The '''Darpa Center of History at Calamar''' was a museum on [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]]. On 14:2:3&mdash;[[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]&mdash;, it hosted the "[[Cradle of the Galaxy]]" exhibit.
